title.zh: 将南高速公路的名称正式变更为Sergio Osmeña Sr.总统公路的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the South Superhighway to President Sergio Osmeña Sr. Highway
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the South Superhighway to President Sergio Osmeña Sr. Highway

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6760_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The South Superhighway stretching from Metro Manila to the Province of Laguna, and any further extension of the same, is hereby renamed President Sergio Osmeña Sr. Highway.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
